realtime_memories.content: Turborepo monorepo with 9 subdomain apps (www, thoughts, dev, links, updates, metrics, status, lab, docs) and shared packages (ui, lib, types, config, styles). CLI app removed Jan 30. Three-layer shared system: @anipotts/lib (plain helpers) → @anipotts/ui (client components with callback props) → per-app actions.ts (thin 'use server' wrappers). Shared packages built with tsup. GitHub: https://github.com/anipotts/anipotts.com.

Required env vars: NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_KEY, NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_HOST, NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, ADMIN_PASSWORD, GITHUB_TOKEN, GITHUB_USERNAME, WAKATIME_API_KEY, CRON_SECRET. Dev: 'pnpm turbo dev --concurrency=15'. Build shared: 'pnpm --filter @anipotts/lib build && pnpm --filter @anipotts/ui build'. Vercel: pnpm 10.x, each app has its own vercel.json. Use printf (not echo) for env vars — echo adds trailing newline that breaks CRON_SECRET validation.

Accent: #61ABEA (blue). Handles: @anipottsbuilds (social), @anipotts (GitHub/LinkedIn). Email: contact@anipotts.com. Bio: 'minimal interfaces to orchestrate complex systems'. Terminal header: 'ani@potts:~/[domain]' with responsive prefix hiding. Font: JetBrains Mono. Design tokens in packages/styles/src/tokens.css (light in :root, dark in .dark).

Shared data in @anipotts/lib with tsup multi-entry builds. Modules: data/ (projects, social, site, services, SITE_VERSION), admin/ (auth, thoughts CRUD with Partial<Thought> types), metrics/ (GitHub stats/languages/commits, WakaTime, Supabase cache), status/ (HTTP checker, Supabase persistence). Supabase tables: thoughts, metrics_cache (key-value JSONB), status_checks, favorite_numbers. Vercel Crons: metrics daily 6AM UTC, status every 5 min. Import Supabase via @anipotts/lib/supabase to avoid pnpm version mismatches.

.gitignore includes .turbo, next-env.d.ts, *.tsbuildinfo. SEO: robots.txt, sitemap.ts, Person schema, OG cards. SubdomainNavigator (Ctrl+`) on www. Admin accessed via Cmd+Shift+A, cookie-based auth per domain. ./server export uses source path (not dist) to avoid tsup dual-config issues. Shared next config in packages/config/next/base.ts — DO NOT use serverExternalPackages for framer-motion (breaks SSG prerendering useContext). Use turbopack.resolveAlias for node:fs stub instead.

Ecosystem unification (Jan 29): shared data layer, admin system, real GitHub+WakaTime metrics, HTTP status monitoring, dynamic dev/updates pages, lab/docs cleanup. Light/dark/system theme (Jan 30): ThemeProvider + ThemeScript + ThemeToggle, CSS variable tokens, WavesBackground theme-aware. Deep cleanup (Jan 30): 8-phase plan completed — security fixes (cron auth, input validation), dead code removal (~1000 lines), dependency alignment (framer-motion 12.23.25 pinned, React 19.2.1), shared next config (baseNextConfig), layout dedup (TerminalBackground + TerminalHeader shared components, inline providers per layout), type safety (Thought types, PostHog guards, try/catch, generateMetadata for thoughts), accessibility (focus-visible, prefers-reduced-motion), CLI app removed. All 9 apps build + typecheck clean.
